I've written the migrated file to `out/module.ts`, and it passes type checking. `npm run size -- out/module.ts` reports 1937 bytes (min+gzip) and 102 bytes of own code. I didn't run the original for comparison, since lodash isn't installed.

- **`applyPatch`** uses `merge` from `es-toolkit`. I checked that it mutates `base` and merges arrays by index, as lodash does.
- **`toTitle`** uses `startCase` from `es-toolkit/compat`. The core `startCase` lowercases acronyms: `"XMLHttp"` becomes `"Xml Http"` where lodash gives `"XML Http"`. The compat version matches lodash on every case I tried.
- **`toLookup`** uses native `Object.fromEntries(pairs)`, because `es-toolkit` has no `fromPairs` outside compat. It gives the same result as lodash `fromPairs` for these inputs, with the last duplicate winning. The compat `fromPairs` made the bundle 72 bytes larger (2009) but cut own code to 85 bytes. I picked `Object.fromEntries` to keep the bundle smaller; the cost is 17 more bytes of own code.

No lodash imports remain, and I installed nothing. `tsc` still reports errors for `src/module.ts` because lodash isn't installed, but none for `out/`.
